text: The illustration sidecar can be rewritten with a headline-glued, truncated alt (observed 'Your 6 Fixes, One Hidden Code. Insurance notice and public file pages... roof type', 118 chars) and its typography overlay can be set from the lead and clipped mid-sentence ('...refused to keep a home policy. Each'). Both survive the publish summary because the render gate reads bytes, not copy. After a persistence pass, read the header pixels with vision and diff the sidecar alt against the artifact: retype the overlay free with illustration_overlay.apply_to_slug(slug, force_copy=...) from featured.base.jpg, then fix alt/caption in the sidecar, the artifact, the Supabase metadata and the attachment, and push the corrected bytes with wp_draft.py --slug <slug> --reimage (update_media alone changes meta, not pixels). The front can keep serving the old alt until the attachment meta lands.
